## Situation
Four newer engineers at Example Systems struggled to get changes through code review.

## Task
I was asked to mentor the engineers and lead code review for the platform team.

## Action
I paired with each engineer weekly and wrote review guidelines because inconsistent feedback caused most of the delay.

## Result
Review time dropped from 5 days to 2 days for the four engineers.
